meta.description: Five self-paced reading experiments that vary whether an entity of a short passage is realized by a pronoun or by a repeated name. Experiment 1 measures the total reading time of the passage; Experiments 2 to 5 measure the reading time of a critical sentence. The tests that bear on the repeated-name penalty are given as printed, by subjects (F1, t1) and by passages (F2, t2); a statistic printed only as less than 1 has no value and no p-value.
